name: Fiserv (legacy ticker, rebranded to FI)
blurb: FISV was the long-standing ticker for Fiserv, a financial-technology firm specializing in payments processing, core banking software, and merchant acquiring (Clover). In 2024 the company shortened its symbol to FI; references to $FISV in posts after that date are using the legacy symbol for the same underlying company.
recent: Fiserv (FI) traded near multi-year lows through late 2025 and early 2026 amid margin compression, slowing Clover growth, and competitive pressure from Stripe, Block and Toast. Shares are off roughly 60% from 2023 highs.
